reguloj.name: contrast-pairs-declared
reguloj.statement: Every foreground, border and focus colour token is the foreground of a KontrastParo, and every background colour token its background; tokens with the role disabled or decorative are exempt.
reguloj.kialo: Contrast must be provable per combination (Art. X): the Alirebleco check only evaluates declared KontrastParoj across all resolutions, so an undeclared text-on-background or border-on-background pairing is an unchecked accessibility risk.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color tokens with role foreground, background or border

reguloj.name: semantic-colors-alias-palette
reguloj.statement: Semantic color tokens in core reference palette tokens instead of literal color values.
reguloj.kialo: Aspektoj and Dimensioj then change a color by overriding one palette token, and late binding carries the change to every semantic use in every combination; a literal in a semantic token would silently opt out of that and drift between combinations.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: core color tokens outside color.palette

reguloj.name: color-roles-declared
reguloj.statement: Every colour token declares its role: palette for primitives; foreground, background, border, focus, shadow, backdrop, disabled or decorative for semantic colours.
reguloj.kialo: Roles tell the contrast gate which colours must be paired and tell agents how a colour may be used; a colour without a role can be neither checked nor explained.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color tokens in core

reguloj.name: dimensio-sets-alias-only
reguloj.statement: Sets without an aspekto condition (generic Dimensio sets) hold aliases only and only re-point tokens that are aliases in core (roles); primitives change only per Aspekto.
reguloj.kialo: Generic Dimensio sets outrank every Aspekto set, so whatever they hold reaches every brand. A literal or a re-pointed primitive there would make every Aspekto inherit a core value, which Article IV forbids; re-pointing roles lets each Aspekto keep its own values in every combination.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: sets without an aspekto condition

reguloj.name: density-affects-layout-only
reguloj.statement: The density Dimensio re-points spacing and control-size roles only; it never changes typography. viewport and density never shift the same token.
reguloj.kialo: Density is layout compactness, font size is legibility and belongs to viewport. If viewport and density shifted the same token, the result would depend on their priority order and be predictable for nobody.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: sets density/*

reguloj.name: aspekto-complete
reguloj.statement: Every Aspekto except the reference overrides every core token in its own set aspekto/<name>; identical aliases count, conjunction sets carry deltas only.
reguloj.kialo: An Aspekto is a complete assignment of the Vortaro (Article IV). If a brand could leave a token out, it would silently inherit the reference brand's value, and a forgotten token would surface at the customer instead of in validation.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: Aspekto packages

reguloj.name: disabled-exempt-from-contrast
reguloj.statement: Colour tokens with the role disabled or decorative need no KontrastParo.
reguloj.kialo: WCAG 2.x exempts inactive components (1.4.3) and decoration that carries no information (1.4.11). Forcing contrast on them would make disabled controls look actionable and dividers look like content.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color tokens with role disabled or decorative

reguloj.name: typography-roles-composite
reguloj.statement: Every typography role is a composite whose fields are aliases: size, line height and letter spacing alias role tokens, family and weight alias primitives.
reguloj.kialo: Dimensioj then shift role tokens along the scales and never restate a composite, which would overwrite an Aspekto's weight or family; one role per text style keeps every Projekcio and every agent on the same names.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: typography.*

reguloj.name: motion-reduced-instant
reguloj.statement: Under motion=reduced every duration role is the instant step and every easing role is linear.
reguloj.kialo: People who ask their system to reduce motion must not see animated transitions; making every duration instant through the scale keeps components working without special cases and lets each Aspekto define what instant means.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: sets motion/reduced

reguloj.name: focus-ring-dual-contrast
reguloj.statement: Every focus colour is the foreground of a KontrastParo on color.background.default and of one on its gap colour color.focus.inner.
reguloj.kialo: A single ring colour cannot reach 3:1 against a white surface, a dark inverse surface and a filled primary action at the same time. The ring therefore sits on its own gap colour and must contrast with that gap and with the surface around it, as WCAG 2.4.13 describes for focus indicators.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color tokens with role focus; data/kontrastparoj.json

reguloj.name: surface-order
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, the OKLCH lightness of color.background.sunken ≤ canvas ≤ default ≤ raised, in both colour schemes; transparent values are composited over color.background.default first.
reguloj.kialo: The surface hierarchy carries spatial meaning: sunken areas sit below the page and raised ones above it. A break is visible to every user and to no contrast check, so it must be checked on its own (Constitution Art. VI, finding from the ciferecigo acceptance).
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.background.sunken, canvas, default and raised in every combination

reguloj.name: semantic-described
reguloj.statement: Every role token in core (its value is an alias, or a composite with an alias field) has a $description that states its use: not empty, no alias reference and no colour value.
reguloj.kialo: Agents read values from bare token files but not the purpose of a token; with a description per role token they choose the right token for a use, for example a destructive action. The description is input for agents, not documentation, so it must describe the use rather than repeat the value.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: role tokens in core

reguloj.name: text-hierarchy
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, color.text.default, color.text.subtle and color.text.muted resolve to pairwise different colours, neighbouring roles (default and subtle, subtle and muted) differ by at least 0.05 in OKLCH lightness after compositing, and their contrast against color.background.default does not rise from default to subtle to muted.
reguloj.kialo: The text roles carry a distinction of meaning. High contrast must strengthen them, not erase them, and a contrast check does not see a collapse because every collapsed role still passes. Under contrast=high the main role takes the maximum contrast the ramp offers, so subtle and muted keep their own steps. Distinct is not distinguishable; a hierarchy the eye does not see does not exist.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.text.default, subtle and muted in every combination

reguloj.name: state-distinct
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, the OKLCH lightness of color.action.<v>.hover, .pressed and .selected differs from .rest by at least 0.05, for every action variant; transparent values are composited over color.background.default first.
reguloj.kialo: A state that looks like the rest state gives no feedback, and a difference in hue alone disappears in greyscale and for people with a colour-vision deficiency; no contrast check sees either. The difference must be clear, not just perceptible: 0.05 is 2.5 times the typical just-noticeable difference and leaves a reserve for poor displays and colour-vision deficiency.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.action.<v>.hover, pressed, selected against rest in every combination

reguloj.name: one-primary-per-container
reguloj.statement: A container holds at most one butono with variant=primary; instances without a named container count as one container.
reguloj.kialo: Two equal calls to action move the decision onto the user; one primary action makes the next step obvious, and every other action steps back as secondary or tertiary.
reguloj.scope: eroj: butono instances in a design or in code (check_usage)

reguloj.name: destructive-not-primary-color
reguloj.statement: An action that destroys data is never a butono with variant=primary and tone=default: as the main action (a confirmation dialog) it is primary with tone=danger, next to another primary action it is secondary.
reguloj.kialo: The primary colour promises the expected next step; a destructive action needs a colour that warns before it acts, and a danger fill only where the destruction is the step the user came for.
reguloj.scope: eroj: butono instances whose intent is destructive or whose label is a destructive keyword of the Skemo

reguloj.name: label-required
reguloj.statement: Every butono has a visible label or, when it shows only an icon, a label prop as its accessible name.
reguloj.kialo: A button without a name cannot be found or understood by assistive technology, and an icon alone is not understood by everyone; the name is what a screen reader announces and what voice control listens for.
reguloj.scope: eroj: butono instances; the rendered check (axe) confirms the accessible name

reguloj.name: touch-target-min
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, every size.control.* resolves to at least size.target.min, the minimum pointer target of WCAG 2.5.8 (24 px).
reguloj.kialo: WCAG 2.5.8 (AA) requires a target of at least 24 by 24 px; smaller targets fail people with tremor, with large fingers or on a moving device. The threshold is a token, so the rule and the rendered component read the same value.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: size.control.* against size.target.min in every combination

reguloj.name: contrast-reserve
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, every KontrastParo exceeds the WCAG 2.x threshold that binds it by at least the sojlo; the branch that carries the result is the one measured.
reguloj.kialo: Meeting a threshold exactly means missing it on the next screen: font smoothing, a cheap panel, a translucent edge or a rounded value all cost a few percent. A reserve makes the promise hold outside the calculation, and it is the difference between a value that passes a test and a value that works.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: every KontrastParo in every combination

reguloj.name: surface-distinct
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, neighbouring surface roles (sunken, canvas, default, raised) differ in OKLCH lightness by at least the sojlo.
reguloj.kialo: If two surfaces share a lightness, only the shadow carries the layering — and the shadow is gone in high contrast, in forced colours, in print and on a screenshot. A layer that exists in the model must be visible in the value, not only in an effect.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.background.sunken, canvas, default, raised in every combination

reguloj.name: palette-even
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, a palette ramp falls strictly in OKLCH lightness, and no inner step differs from the median step of its ramp by more than the sojlo. The first and the last step of a ramp, the anchors (pure white, pure black) and alpha ramps are out.
reguloj.kialo: A ramp is a tool: whoever says 'one step darker' must get the same effect in the middle of every ramp. How fine a brand grades the ends is its own business — near white the eye needs smaller steps — but a jump in the middle makes the ramp unusable and shows up as a band in every gradient built from it.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.palette.<ramp>.<step> in every combination

reguloj.name: palette-aligned
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, ramps that share a step number stay within the sojlo of each other in OKLCH lightness.
reguloj.kialo: A role picks a step number, not a colour. If step 700 is dark in one ramp and mid in another, the same role weighs differently depending on its hue, and every rule built on steps stops being portable.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.palette.<ramp>.<step> across ramps, in every combination

reguloj.name: srgb-gamut
reguloj.statement: Every colour token resolves to components inside 0 … 1 of its colour space, in every combination of every Aspekto.
reguloj.kialo: A component outside the gamut is clipped by the browser. The clipped colour is not the colour the contrast was computed from, so a value outside the gamut turns every measurement in this repository into a guess.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: every colour token in every combination

reguloj.name: type-scale
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, the ratios of neighbouring steps of font.size.scale stay within the sojlo of the median ratio of the scale.
reguloj.kialo: A scale must be predictable: a designer who moves one step up expects the same jump everywhere, and a brand that is derived from another needs a rule it can recompute. Which ratio a brand picks, and whether it rounds to whole pixels, stays its own decision.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: font.size.scale.* in every combination

reguloj.name: type-rhythm
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, the line height and the letter spacing of the typography roles fall as the font size grows.
reguloj.kialo: Long lines of large type need less leading and tighter tracking to stay one block of text; leading that grows with the size tears a headline apart. That is legibility, measurable and independent of taste.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: typography.* in every combination
